notes: Run of 2026-11-17. Six Standard stories queued. findings.description: Momo Noodle, a Sichuan fast-casual restaurant with a first shop at 455 Market, has taken the storefront at 226 Kearny St. for a second location opening in December.

citation.label: The San Francisco Standard, “More bàn miàn downtown: A Sichuan noodle restaurant expands in Union Square,” 16 November 2026

raw.text: they’ll open next month at 226 Kearny St.

EAS puts 222, 224, 226 KEARNY ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 222.

publish.note: Entry on the existing page /san-francisco/union-square/kearny-street/222/ (226 Kearny resolves to the parcel's lowest number, 222) as sf-standard-2026-11-16, and card on the homepage grid.
